title: Contrast Ratio
description: Text must have 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background for normal text 3:1 for large text
do_dont: do:use tools to verify contrast dont:rely on visual estimation

title: Alt Text
description: Every image must have descriptive alt text or be marked decorative for screen readers
do_dont: do:describe image purpose dont:use file names as alt text

title: Keyboard Navigation
description: All interactive elements must be reachable and operable via keyboard alone
do_dont: do:test with Tab key dont:rely only on mouse interaction

title: Focus Indicators
description: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements never remove without replacement
do_dont: do:use visible focus styles dont:use outline:none without alternative

title: Semantic HTML
description: Use proper HTML elements header nav main article section footer
do_dont: do:use semantic elements dont:use divs for everything

title: ARIA Labels
description: Add aria-labels to icon buttons and controls without visible text
do_dont: do:add aria-label to icon buttons dont:leave controls unlabeled

title: Color Independence
description: Never use color alone to convey information use icons text or patterns
do_dont: do:use multiple indicators dont:rely on color only for status

title: Form Labels
description: Every form input must have an associated label visible or via aria-label
do_dont: do:use explicit labels dont:use placeholder as only label

title: Reduced Motion
description: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for animations
do_dont: do:provide reduced motion alternative dont:force animations on all users

title: Heading Hierarchy
description: Maintain logical heading hierarchy h1 through h6 without skipping levels
do_dont: do:follow sequential order dont:skip heading levels for styling

title: Minimum Touch Target
description: Interactive elements minimum 44x44px touch target size
do_dont: do:ensure 44px minimum dont:make buttons too small

title: Touch Spacing
description: Minimum 8px spacing between adjacent touch targets
do_dont: do:space elements adequately dont:place buttons too close

title: Loading Feedback
description: Show loading indicators for actions taking more than 300ms
do_dont: do:show spinners or progress dont:leave users guessing

title: Gesture Alternatives
description: Provide button alternatives for complex swipe or pinch gestures
do_dont: do:offer tap alternatives dont:rely on gestures only

title: Hover State
description: Provide hover states for desktop but dont rely on hover for critical info
do_dont: do:add hover feedback dont:hide essential info behind hover

title: Haptic Feedback
description: Use subtle haptic feedback for important mobile interactions
do_dont: do:use vibration for confirmations dont:overuse haptic feedback

title: Image Optimization
description: Use WebP or AVIF format with responsive srcset for all images
do_dont: do:use modern image formats dont:serve uncompressed images

title: Lazy Loading
description: Implement lazy loading for below-fold images and heavy components
do_dont: do:use loading=lazy dont:load everything upfront

title: Layout Stability
description: Reserve space for dynamic content to prevent layout shift CLS < 0.1
do_dont: do:set explicit dimensions dont:load content without placeholder space

title: Font Loading
description: Use font-display:swap and preload critical fonts
do_dont: do:use font-display swap dont:block rendering for fonts

title: Code Splitting
description: Split JavaScript bundles and load code on demand
do_dont: do:use dynamic imports dont:bundle everything together

title: Critical CSS
description: Inline critical above-fold CSS and defer non-critical
do_dont: do:inline critical styles dont:load all CSS upfront

title: Debounce Throttle
description: Debounce scroll resize and input handlers
do_dont: do:debounce event handlers dont:fire handlers on every event

title: Virtual Lists
description: Use virtual scrolling for lists with more than 100 items
do_dont: do:virtualize long lists dont:render all items at once

title: Style Consistency
description: Maintain consistent design language across all pages and components
do_dont: do:follow design system dont:mix different styles randomly

title: SVG Icons
description: Use SVG icons from Heroicons or Lucide never emoji as icons
do_dont: do:use SVG icon libraries dont:use emoji as functional icons

title: Design Tokens
description: Use design tokens for colors spacing typography never hardcoded values
do_dont: do:reference CSS variables dont:use raw hex or px values

title: Visual Hierarchy
description: Establish clear visual hierarchy with size weight and color
do_dont: do:use typography scale dont:make all text same size

title: White Space
description: Use generous white space to reduce cognitive load
do_dont: do:provide breathing room dont:clutter interfaces

title: Responsive Breakpoints
description: Build mobile-first with breakpoints at 375px 768px 1024px 1440px
do_dont: do:start with mobile styles dont:build desktop first

title: Mobile First
description: Design for mobile screens first then enhance for larger screens
do_dont: do:write mobile CSS first dont:override desktop with mobile

title: No Horizontal Scroll
description: Content must never cause horizontal scrolling on any screen size
do_dont: do:test on small screens dont:use fixed width containers

title: Viewport Meta
description: Always include viewport meta tag with user-scalable=yes
do_dont: do:allow zoom dont:disable user scaling

title: CSS Grid Flexbox
description: Use CSS Grid for 2D layouts Flexbox for 1D component layouts
do_dont: do:choose appropriate layout dont:use floats for layout

title: Container Widths
description: Use max-width containers with responsive padding
do_dont: do:constrain content width dont:let content stretch full screen

title: Sticky Headers
description: Use sticky navigation for quick access to main actions
do_dont: do:make nav accessible dont:hide navigation on scroll

title: Base Font Size
description: Set base body font size to 16px minimum for readability
do_dont: do:use 16px base dont:use smaller than 14px body text

title: Line Height
description: Use 1.5 line height for body text 1.2 for headings
do_dont: do:provide adequate line height dont:use tight line spacing

title: Line Length
description: Keep body text lines between 50-75 characters for readability
do_dont: do:constrain line length dont:make lines too long

title: Font Pairing
description: Maximum 2 font families per project one for headings one for body
do_dont: do:limit font variety dont:use more than 2 fonts

title: Type Scale
description: Use consistent type scale with clear hierarchy
do_dont: do:follow type scale dont:randomly size text

title: Dark Mode Text
description: Ensure text remains readable in dark mode with proper contrast
do_dont: do:test both modes dont:forget dark mode contrast

title: Semantic Tokens
description: Use semantic color tokens like primary secondary accent not raw hex
do_dont: do:use CSS variables dont:hardcode colors in components

title: Dark Mode Contrast
description: Test all color combinations in both light and dark modes
do_dont: do:verify both themes dont:assume colors work everywhere

title: Accessible Pairs
description: Choose color combinations that work for color-blind users
do_dont: do:test with color blindness tools dont:rely on red-green only

title: Color Limiting
description: Use maximum 5-6 colors in a palette for consistency
do_dont: do:limit palette size dont:use too many colors

title: Status Colors
description: Use consistent status colors green success red error yellow warning
do_dont: do:use standard status colors dont:reinvent status indicators

title: Duration Keep animation duration between 150ms and 300ms for natural feel
description: MEDIUM
priority: do:use 150-300ms dont:make animations too slow or instant

title: Easing
description: Use ease-out for entering elements ease-in for exiting elements
do_dont: do:use appropriate easing dont:use linear for everything

title: Reduced Motion
description: Always provide alternative for users who prefer reduced motion
do_dont: do:respect prefers-reduced-motion dont:force animations

title: Purpose
description: Motion should convey meaning or guide attention not decorative
do_dont: do:animate with purpose dont:add animation for its own sake

title: Exit Speed
description: Exit animations should be faster than enter animations typically 0.75x
do_dont: do:make exits faster dont:use same duration for enter exit

title: Spatial Continuity
description: Animated elements should move in direction consistent with user action
do_dont: do:maintain spatial logic dont:animate randomly

title: Visible Labels
description: Form inputs must have visible labels not just placeholder text
do_dont: do:show labels above inputs dont:use placeholder as only label

title: Error Placement
description: Show validation errors near the relevant form field
do_dont: do:place errors inline dont:show all errors at form top

title: Helper Text
description: Provide helper text for complex fields with format examples
do_dont: do:add helper text dont:leave users guessing format

title: Progressive Disclosure
description: Show essential fields first reveal additional fields as needed
do_dont: do:group related fields dont:overwhelm with all fields upfront

title: Input Types
description: Use correct input types email tel url number for better mobile UX
do_dont: do:use proper input types dont:text for everything

title: Auto Focus
description: Auto-focus first input on form pages but avoid on modal open
do_dont: do:focus first field dont:auto-focus when modal opens

title: Predictable Back
description: Browser back button must always work correctly
do_dont: do:test back button dont:break browser history

title: Bottom Nav Limit
description: Mobile bottom navigation maximum 5 items
do_dont: do:limit nav items dont:overload bottom navigation

title: Deep Linking
description: All important pages must be accessible via direct URL
do_dont: do:enable deep links dont:require sequential navigation

title: Breadcrumbs
description: Show breadcrumbs for nested navigation deeper than 2 levels
do_dont: do:add breadcrumbs dont:leave users lost in hierarchy

title: Active State
description: Clearly indicate current page or section in navigation
do_dont: do:highlight active item dont:leave navigation ambiguous

title: Search
description: Provide search functionality for content-heavy sites
do_dont: do:add search for large sites dont:make users browse everything

title: Chart Legends
description: Always include legends for charts with multiple data series
do_dont: do:add clear legends dont:assume colors are self-explanatory

title: Tooltips
description: Add interactive tooltips with detailed values on hover
do_dont: do:show detailed values on hover dont:hide exact numbers

title: Accessible Colors
description: Use color-blind friendly palettes for chart data series
do_dont: do:test color combinations dont:rely on red-green differentiation

title: Data Labels
description: Add data labels for important points to improve readability
do_dont: do:label key data points dont:force users to estimate values

title: Responsive Charts
description: Make charts responsive and readable on all screen sizes
do_dont: do:test on mobile dont:assume desktop-only viewing
